records.excerpt: HM Land Registry Price Paid Data covers property sales in England and Wales sold for value and lodged for registration. The official page provides CSV, text and linked-data access, states monthly updating, and licenses Price Paid Data under the Open Government Licence v3.0 subject to third-party address rights.
records.record_scope: official source page relevant to bounded exact-postcode Price Paid Data research

records.excerpt: The official guidance defines property type, old/new, tenure and address fields including postcode, PAON, SAON, street, locality, town, district and county. It warns that downloaded property characteristics describe the registration or transaction record and can differ from later search results when a property changes.
records.record_scope: official source page relevant to bounded exact-postcode Price Paid Data research

records.excerpt: The official Land Registry linked-data ontology identifies Monthly Land Registry Price Paid Data, states that the store contains the same data published as the monthly CSV, exposes SPARQL query and JSON result options, and links to the endpoint page.
